Dear [Mr Bullock](/person/221),
I will try to do [Raymond Lull](/book/358) in short by the end of next week, I have both the books.[^2]
You will be glad to hear that I have had a cheerful letter from Miss [Florence Wilford](/person/1520) well, and at home with her [sister](/person/1519)[^3]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd J.F.

Bullock/Radwinter Rectory/Saffron Walden.’ Postmark MR 16/95.
[^2]: Raymond Lull (1232-1315), missionary and philosopher.
[^3]: Florence Wilford seems to have been confined in a lunatic asylum in later life.
